# ezy Logistic HUB

> Simple, all-in-one logistics platform to manage shipments, orders, inventory, invoices, and warehouses for small and growing businesses.

ezy Logistic HUB (EzySuite) is a multi-tenant SaaS ERP focused on logistics, procurement, sales, and finance. The marketing site is public; the application itself requires sign-in.

## Full documentation

- [Complete project documentation](/llms-full.txt): every module, workflow, security rule, backend function, and the MCP server — the best single link to give an AI.
